instruction: Add the prefix 'mountain_' to all image filenames in my Pictures directory.

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding 'mountain_' prefix to all 3 image filenames. Evaluator uses image_script.py to get hash-to-filename mapping and verifies that all 3 image hashes map to filenames starting with 'mountain_'.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically correct and can verify the instruction
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter as rules dictionary (expected.get('prefix'), expected.get('image_hashes'))
Content-hash based approach is robust - identifies images by content rather than filename, correctly handling rename operations
Complete coverage - checks all 3 downloaded images for prefix requirement
Appropriate all-or-nothing scoring for this task (returns 1.0 only if all images have correct prefix)
Metric logic correctly iterates through all image hashes and verifies both existence in result and prefix match
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Cannot verify image_script.py implementation - external dependency downloaded in postconfig but not visible for validation
Cannot verify that the 3 SHA256 hashes in expected.image_hashes actually correspond to the downloaded images (picture1.jpg, picture2.jpg, picture3.jpg)
Assume image_script.py correctly computes SHA256 hashes of all images in /home/user/Pictures/ and outputs JSON mapping {hash: filename}
Minor: Metric could add more robust error handling for malformed JSON output from image_script.py
